attributes.name: Smooth Fox Terrier
attributes.description: The Smooth Fox Terrier is a small breed of terrier from England. These dogs are small in size, with a short and smooth coat of fur. They have a lively and energetic demeanor, with an instinct for hunting. They are highly intelligent and trainable, but require firm and consistent training to be obedient. They are loyal and devoted to their family, but can be stubborn and independent at times.
